operators.name: adaptive_avg_pool3d_2
semantics: Computes adaptive average pooling over 3D spatial dimensions (depth, height, width) for each batch and channel independently.
Output spatial size is (output_size, output_size, output_size); pooling regions are calculated as in torch.nn.AdaptiveAvgPool3d with output_size=2.
For output index i in each dimension, start = floor(i * input_size / output_size), end = ceil((i+1) * input_size / output_size); average over all elements in the region.
Input tensor may be non-contiguous; implementation must handle arbitrary strides or explicitly make contiguous before computing.
No bias or extra parameters; only averaging over window.
Output shape [512, 3, 2, 2, 2], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Each output element is the average of the corresponding adaptive pooling window in the input.
